deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$AIO_DEPLOYMENT_MODE" = "staging" ]; then php artisan aio:production-check || true; else php artisan aio:production-check; fi && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan optimize && (php artisan schedule:work > /tmp/aio-scheduler.log 2>&1 &) && exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT'
